spans.s: स्थेमन् m. Firmness, stability, fixedness, न यत्र स्तेमानं दधुरतिभयभ्रांतनयनाः Bh.V.i.32.
स्थेय (I) a. (f. या) To be placed, to be settled or determined.
स्थेय (II) m. 1. A person chosen to settle a dispute, an arbitrator, an umpire, a judge; 2. a domestic priest.
